description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for throttling, including methods to get interval and limit, render config to a Config object, and create instances from a Config. It also includes an enum for default config values and paths.

classes.name: ThrottlingConfig
classes.description: An interface providing methods to access throttling configuration parameters such as interval and limit, render configuration to a Config object, and static methods to create instances from Config. Also contains nested enum for known config values.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the consumer throttling interval as a Duration object.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the consumer throttling limit as an integer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a Config object representing the current throttling configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThrottlingConfig instance based on a provided Config object.
